b2-49.title: Movie night at home
b2-49.story: On Friday evening, Anna and Max couldn't agree on a [[genre]] for movie night. Max wanted [[sci-fi]], but Anna was in the mood for a light [[sitcom]]. In the end, they watched the [[trailer]] for a space adventure together. Then Taras found a [[preview]] online and got excited, because it was a [[remake]] of Dad's favorite old film. Just as the movie started, Max almost gave away a [[spoiler]] from a review he had read. Anna threw a pillow at him, and he promised to stay quiet. After that, the [[suspense]] kept everyone on the edge of their seats. When the credits rolled, Taras asked if they could download the [[soundtrack]]. Next Friday, Anna gets to choose the movie.

b2-50.title: Life online
b2-50.story: Last week, Anna's phone kept freezing, so she asked for help on a tech [[forum]]. At first, a [[troll]] replied with silly insults instead of advice. Anna ignored him, but the [[trolling]] continued under her post for hours. Finally, a [[moderator]] stepped in and deleted the rude comments. Then a user with thousands of [[followers|follower]] explained how to clear the phone's memory step by step. It worked, and Anna shared the tip with a [[hashtag]] so others could find it. Max sent her a [[meme]] about phones that never listen to their owners. Lisa replied with a dancing cat [[gif]], and Ira added a [[tag]] so the post would show up under "phone tips." Anna realized that a helpful online [[community]] is worth more than any app.

b2-51.title: TV night at Grandma's
b2-51.story: Every evening, Grandma and Grandpa argue about what to watch on TV. Grandpa never misses his favorite [[game show]], where people answer questions to win a car. Grandma prefers the [[talent show]], because she loves the young singers. Unfortunately, both programs are on during [[prime time]] on Tuesdays. Last Tuesday, Grandpa even skipped the cooking [[segment]] of the news just to keep the remote. Then Anna came over and explained how [[streaming]] works. She set up a [[streaming service]] on their TV so they could watch one program later. Now her grandparents have twice as much [[entertainment]] and no more arguments.

b2-52.title: A gamer's evening
b2-52.story: Max spends most Friday evenings [[gaming]] with his friends. Last Friday, he turned on his [[console]] and found that his [[controller]] wasn't working. Luckily, Sofia lent him hers, though she made him promise to be careful. They were playing a new [[RPG]], and its [[gameplay]] was surprisingly easy to learn. First, Max chose a knight as his [[avatar]] and joined his friends' [[squad]]. In the final battle, he pulled off a perfect [[combo]] and defeated the dragon. The screen showed that he had beaten his own [[high score]]. That night, Max told Sofia that he wants to become a [[game developer]] one day. Sofia laughed and said he should start by repairing his broken one first.

b2-53.title: My first video blog
b2-53.story: Anna decided to try [[blogging]] and make her first video about her hobbies. She talked about the [[anime]] she watches on weekends and the [[manga]] she reads before bed. Max lent her a small voice [[recorder]], because the sound on her phone was terrible. Editing was harder than she expected, and she spent an hour moving clips around the [[timeline]]. At the end, she asked viewers to check their sources and never to share [[fake news]]. The next day, her video had fifty views, and Taras proudly said that forty of them were his.

b2-54.title: A night of celebrity life
b2-54.story: Lisa won two tickets to a film premiere in Kyiv and invited Ira. There was so much [[hype]] around the event that the whole street was full of fans. The [[paparazzi]] were taking photos of everyone who walked down the red carpet. The girls weren't [[VIPs|VIP]], so they had to stand behind a fence. Still, when the lead actress came closer, Ira asked for her [[autograph]], and a huge [[bodyguard]] let her through. For a moment, Lisa could feel the [[glamour]] of [[showbiz]]. Later, a talent [[scout]] noticed Lisa's confident smile and gave her a business card. That evening, Lisa rewrote the [[bio]] on her profile: "Future actress."

b2-55.title: Making an indie film
b2-55.story: Sofia wants to be a [[filmmaker]], so this summer she made a short film with her friends. Max agreed to be the [[cameraman]], although he had never filmed anything before. They chose their grandparents' village as the [[setting]], because the old houses looked perfect for the story. Anna became the [[narrator]], and her calm voice tied all the scenes together. Sofia believes that good [[storytelling]] matters more than expensive equipment. For the music, she used songs by a local band that plays [[indie]]. Grandpa even found an old photo [[negative]] of the village from 1970 and printed it for the opening scene. In August, they showed the finished film at a [[drive-in]] outside the city. Everyone watched from their parents' cars and honked at the end instead of clapping.

b2-56.title: A creepy fantasy film
b2-56.story: On Halloween, Taras wanted to watch a fantasy movie with his big sister. Anna chose one with a brave [[hobbit]] and a wise [[elf]] who travel through a dark forest. Halfway through, a [[goblin]] stole their map, and Taras hid under a blanket. Then the heroes reached a castle where an old [[vampire]] lived, and the music became really [[creepy]]. Anna paused the movie when the castle's cook turned out to be a [[cannibal]], because she thought it was too scary. But Taras insisted he wasn't afraid and asked her to keep going. In the end, the little hero saved everyone, and Taras said he had been as brave as a [[superman]]. Still, he asked Anna to leave the hallway light on that night.
